rca of the issue: Root cause: user's local file browser hides dotfiles by default, so the original template file /app/backend/.env.example (leading dot) was invisible to them during setup. Mitigation shipped: added non-hidden visible aliases /app/backend/env.example and /app/frontend/env.example (no leading dot) with the same key set, plus a rename-hint comment header. .gitignore was updated with two additional whitelist rules `!env.example` and `!**/env.example` (lines 93-94) so the new visible templates remain tracked. Verified: (a) both visible and hidden templates exist and are byte-identical in key set, (b) backend/.env real secrets file remains git-ignored by `*.env` (line 90) since whitelist rules do not match `.env` files, (c) backend runtime unaffected — /api/ still reports gpt-5.4-mini and the multi-agent refund flow works end-to-end with a real Emergent LLM call.
